shared_elements: relief carving on an upright stone slab/monolith
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief creatures, and each includes a quadruped in profile alongside a long sinuous serpentine form, plus curled/spiral details — but these are generic correspondences. A is a dense, horror-vacui composition of interlocking anthropomorphic figures, masks and sign-like glyphic elements filling every register, while B shows just two isolated, sparse, schematic animals stacked on a plain field with large empty ground, so the compositional logic and rendering conventions differ fundamentally.
